subject: The 3AM proposal that started with a card
preview_text: A couple used SoulPlan to plan a proposal. Here's the feature they tapped.
body_paragraphs: A few weeks ago, a user opened SoulPlan at 3AM, tapped Tonight's Date, picked 'adventurous,' and planned a surprise proposal by the end of the night. I never expected anyone to use the app this way — but it worked. They sent the card, their partner got the full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment, and two days later they were engaged.

That's the thing about this app: it's built for date nights, sure, but what you do with those 30 seconds is up to you. One couple used it to break a six-month dry spell. Another planned a 'healing' date after a fight and said it saved their weekend. The feature isn't just for dinner — it's a tool to say 'I see you' in a moment that matters.

Your home screen has that same card right now. One tap on a mood — cozy, adventurous, playful, healing — and in 30 seconds, you've got a suggestion that feels personal, not generic. The AI draws from your Wishlist and partner's preferences, but the real magic is that it gives you permission to act fast, without the planning fatigue.

Open SoulPlan right now and tap Tonight's Date. Pick any mood. Then send it to your partner — see what happens. P.S. One user told me they used the 'healing' card to apologize after a fight. The full-screen moment made their partner cry. That's the kind of unexpected use case I live for.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and tap Tonight's Date
